promises.quote: A written guideline will be developed to include routine checking of INR for all patients presenting after a fall who are receiving vitamin-K antagonist anticoagulants, such as warfarin.

promises.quote: The electronic clinical information system used by the Emergency Department will be reconfigured to create a visible alert to the consultant in charge, when a patient's vital signs fall outside normal parameters.
promises.summary: Reconfigure system to alert consultants on abnormal vital signs.

promises.quote: The Emergency Department will develop an audit process to review the appropriate referral of patients for senior review when presenting to the Emergency Department.
promises.summary: Develop audit process for senior review referrals.
